name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 137 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 137 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces have intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting UN warnings of ethnic cleansing, while IDF airstrikes in Gaza have killed a child and targeted two Hamas commanders and other terror operatives linked to financing. Hamas reported the killing of two of its security operatives during a mission in Gaza. A UN panel has accused Israel of extermination in the West Bank and genocide in Gaza, and a UN inquiry found Israel continued genocide in Gaza after a ceasefire. Iran hosted regional powers for talks aimed at preventing fresh escalation, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker har skjerpet nedslaget i Hebron, har fordrevet tusenvis og fått FN til å advare om etnisk rensing, mens IDF-luftangrep i Gaza har drept et barn og truffet to Hamas-kommandører og andre terroroperatører knyttet til finansiering. Hamas rapporterte at to av deres sikkerhetsoperatører ble drept under en operasjon i Gaza. Et FN-panel har anklaget Israel for utryddelse på Vestbredden og folkemord i Gaza, og en FN-undersøkelse fant at Israel fortsatte folkemord i Gaza etter en våpenhvile. Iran var vert for regionale makter i samtaler som hadde som mål å hindre ny opptrapping, og 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
